title: Truchet ribbon
description: Broad honey-colored ribbons join through a wine-red field of curved tiles.
useCase: A seamless connected pattern with consistent endpoints across randomized tile orientations.
reducedMotion: The elapsed-time clock stops. Parameter controls immediately update the static composition.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; a static CSS swatch appears if unavailable or after context loss. Deterministic tile orientations; ribbon width changes continuously without random topology jumps.
look: Thick honey-yellow ribbons with a thin inset rust outline form interlocking rings and S-curves across a flat wine-red field.
motion: The tile field drifts slowly leftward on the shader clock; a range slider thickens or thins the ribbons in real time, and a button pauses the drift.
adapt: The pattern lives in the `FRAGMENT` shader: tune the tile scale and `u_time` drift multiplier in `main`, the `width` range driven by `u_control`, and the `bg` and `yellow` colours. Keep the canvas lifecycle, fallback and reduced-motion handling.
